回到王野家，父母得到答案已经睡觉去了，王野则被赵爷爷叫到自己的小屋。

王野笑嘻嘻的说：“赵爷爷，这么晚了还有事儿呀？”

赵爷爷看着王野也不说话。足足一分多钟后，王野长出了一口气说：“咳，就知道瞒不过赵爷爷。”

老头“嘿嘿”一笑，好像是斗嘴的孩子胜利了一样，说：“那就好好说说吧！”

王野深吸一口气说：“赵爷爷，我刚才说的都是真的，只不过有一点没说。那就是我这个舅舅到底怎么样，我心里不清楚呀！他的出现是一个最大的不稳定因素。我虽然不知道上层是怎样的，但是我知道一点，政敌是自古有之的。”

王野顿了顿继续说：“还有一点，我觉得上面不稳当。”

赵爷爷神色一愣说：“什么意思？”

王野说：“没什么意思，就是觉得上面会有大动荡。”

赵爷爷想了一会儿，他可知道王野说的上面的大动荡是什么。在抗战的时候出过好几次，他都经历过，神色凝重的说：“不会吧？”

王野说：“思想问题一直存在，只是不知道下一次波及多大。”

赵爷爷面色沉重的说：“今天的话跟谁也不要说。”

王野也正色的说：“放心吧！赵爷爷，我知道轻重。”

说完，两人各怀心事的回去睡觉了。

第二天一早王野就起床了，在练功房打了两遍拳就去洗漱了，看着进进出出的邻居，王野心想：“爱咋滴咋滴吧，像人家一样，随着时代的发展过自己的日子。反正自己是个挂逼，惹急了全家逃出去。到哪里都能混的风生水起。最多等风停了再回来发展。”

正在一家人吃饭的时候，秦伟和陈近岳来了。这一次只带了王虎一个人，那个赵兵不见了。一进门秦婉放下碗就迎了上去，王铁柱也跟了上去。

王野只是放下碗看向两人，并没有站起来。

秦婉上前就说：“大哥，你怎么这么早就来了，有什么事儿吗？”

秦伟面露愧色说：“妹子，这不是昨天的事儿，老陈觉得不对，这不特意来道歉的。”

陈近岳赶紧上前一步，把手里的一个袋子放在桌上说：“妹子，妹夫，昨天的事儿是我御下不严，给你们添麻烦了。这是我的一点心意，希望你们不要放在心上。”

秦婉和王铁柱一起看向坐着的王野。王野只好抱着小丫头站起来，就在站起来的过程中，王野就从面无表情挂上了满面春风。

上前一步笑呵呵的说：“陈大爷，这是怎么说的，多大点事儿啊？还劳驾您亲自跑一趟。东西就不用了，带回家给家里的孩子吧！”

陈近岳一下就无语了，这孩子也太不要脸了，昨天晚上他可不是这个态度，那下逐客令时的样子，陈近岳都多少年没见过了。这才多久呀！这脸是书呀？来回翻，想怎么翻就怎么翻。

陈近岳心想：“没办法呀，谁让自己理亏呢！”只能笑脸相迎的说：“小野呀！怎么说都是大爷的错。本来你家跟你舅舅相认，多喜庆的事儿呀！还出了这么一档子事儿。”

“我这不是怕你们心里有刺，闹得以后你跟你舅舅不亲嘛！你是不知道呀，昨天晚上回去了，你这个舅舅差点和我干一架。这不，今天一大早就被你舅舅给抻过来了。”

秦伟说：“小野呀，你放心，就你陈大爷那个警卫员，已经被处理了。”

王野笑呵呵的说：“谢谢舅舅了，既然人都处理了，那就更没问题了！也谢谢陈大爷。”

接下来就是各种寒暄，王野说：“舅舅，陈大爷，你们和我娘继续叙旧吧！我和我爹要上班去了。再不走就要迟到了。”

Back at Wang Ye's house, his parents had gone to bed after getting the answer, and Wang Ye was called to his cabin by Grandpa Zhao.

Wang Ye said with a smile: "Grandpa Zhao, is there anything else you can do at this late hour?"

Grandpa Zhao looked at Wang Ye and said nothing.After more than a minute, Wang Ye let out a long breath and said, "Ahem, I knew I couldn't hide it from Grandpa Zhao."

The old man smiled "hehe", as if the quarreling child had won, and said: "Then let's talk about it!"

Wang Ye took a deep breath and said: "Grandpa Zhao, what I just said is true, but there is one thing I didn't say. That is, I don't know what kind of uncle I am! His appearance is the biggest unstable factor. Although I don't know what the upper class is like, I do know that political enemies have existed since ancient times."

Wang Ye paused and continued: "One more thing, I think the top is not stable."

Grandpa Zhao looked stunned and said, "What do you mean?"

Wang Ye said: "It's not interesting, I just think there will be big turmoil up there."

Grandpa Zhao thought for a while, did he know what the great turmoil above was that Wang Ye was talking about.He had gone out several times during the Anti-Japanese War, and he had experienced them all. He said solemnly, "No way?"

Wang Ye said: "Ideological problems have always existed, but I don't know how big the impact will be next."

Grandpa Zhao said with a serious face: "Don't say anything to anyone today."

Wang Ye also said seriously: "Don't worry! Grandpa Zhao, I know the severity."

After saying that, the two of them went back to sleep with their own thoughts.

Wang Ye got up early the next morning, punched twice in the practice room and then went to wash up. Looking at the neighbors coming in and out, Wang Ye thought: "Do whatever you like, just like others, live your life with the development of the times. Anyway, I am a loser, and I made the whole family run away. I can prosper wherever I go. At most, I can wait until the wind stops and then come back to develop."

While the family was having dinner, Qin Wei and Chen Jinyue came.This time, only Wang Hu was brought with him, and Zhao Bing was missing.As soon as he entered the door, Qin Wan put down his bowl and went to greet him, followed by Wang Tiezhu.

Wang Ye just put down his bowl and looked at the two of them, without standing up.

Qin Wan stepped forward and said, "Brother, why are you here so early? What's the matter?"

Qin Wei looked ashamed and said, "Sister, this didn't happen yesterday. Lao Chen felt something was wrong, so I didn't come here to apologize."

Chen Jinyue hurriedly stepped forward, put a bag in his hand on the table and said, "Sister, brother-in-law, what happened yesterday was because of my lax control, which caused you trouble. This is my intention, I hope you don't take it to heart."

Qin Wan and Wang Tiezhu looked at Wang Ye who was sitting.Wang Ye had no choice but to stand up with the little girl in his arms. In the process of standing up, Wang Ye's face changed from expressionless to full of joy.

He took a step forward and said with a smile: "Uncle Chen, what do you say? What's the big deal? I'd like you to go there in person. There's no need for the things. Just take them home for your children!"

Chen Jinyue was speechless for a moment. This kid was too shameless. He didn't have this attitude last night. Chen Jinyue hadn't seen the way he looked when he was ordered to be kicked out for many years.How long has it been!Is this face a book?Turn it back and forth as much as you want.

Chen Jinyue thought to himself: "There is no way, who can let me be at fault!" He could only say with a smile: "Xiaoye! It's all uncle's fault no matter what. It turns out that your family and your uncle recognized each other, what a happy thing! Such a thing happened."

"Aren't I afraid that you will have a thorn in your heart, and you will not be close to your uncle in the future? You don't know, last night when I went back, your uncle almost had a fight with me. No, your uncle stretched me here early this morning."

Qin Wei said: "Xiaoye, don't worry, your guard, Uncle Chen, has been dealt with."

Wang Ye said with a smile: "Thank you, uncle. Now that everyone has taken care of it, there will be no problem! Thank you, Uncle Chen, too."

Various pleasantries followed. Wang Ye said: "Uncle, Uncle Chen, you and my mother can continue reminiscing about old times! My father and I are going to work. If we don't leave, we will be late."
